text: The bid of R-DS-18 is recorded as one decision record per bid with the lot, the buyer, the account set, the amount and the bid window; no bid table, bid column or bidding value of LOV-LOT-STATUS is added by this pair, and the missing table is raised for the DB story of this service.
why: R-DS-18 records the bid against the lot and the buyer and the service owns bids, but the two tables of the service (context pack; TSD S6 T3.1) carry no bid amount, bid time or bid reference, and LOV-LOT-STATUS (TSD S6 T3.2) has no bidding value. Writing the bid into the decision record keeps the rule satisfied without inventing a column, a table or a list value.
